description: Turn text into l33tsp34k with three intensity levels, from basic (A→4) to full symbol substitution.

faqs.a: Basic replaces A E I O S T; Medium adds L G Z B; Full replaces nearly every letter with symbols like # for H and |_| for U.
faqs.q: What do the three levels change?

faqs.a: No — leetspeak is lossy (both L and I become 1), so decoding is not offered.
Most substitutions use common ASCII symbols so the result stays readable in games, chats and usernames.

howto: Pick a level: Basic, Medium or Full.
title: Leetspeak Converter
